s.note: Cheddar and oat biscuits, cut like bones. Mary Jane says they're 100% vegetarian.
s.how: Pulse the flour, oats, butter, cheese and paprika in a food processor until it looks like breadcrumbs. Add the yolk and water and pulse until it comes together, then wrap and chill for 10 minutes. Roll out 5mm thick and cut into bone shapes. Bake on a lined tray at 180C until golden, then cool on the tray.

s.note: Mini cheese and tomato pizzas, mild peppers on the side. Scooby eats the whole jar of peppers.
s.how: Stir the passata with the oregano and a pinch of salt. Spread over the bases and top with mozzarella and tomatoes. Bake at 220C until bubbling and crisp, then cut into wedges. Scatter with basil and serve the peppers in a jar on the side for the brave.
shop: 4 small pita breads or pizza bases@Bakery

m.n: All-you-can-eat huli huli chicken with pineapple rice
m.note: Sticky pineapple and soy chicken, coconut rice. Spooky Island's all-you-can-eat deal.
m.how: Whisk the pineapple juice, soy, tomato sauce, sugar, ginger and garlic, keep a third aside and marinate the chicken in the rest for 15 minutes. Cook the rice in the coconut milk topped up with water until fluffy, then fold through the pineapple. Grill the chicken over medium heat, turning and basting with the kept sauce, until sticky and cooked through. Slice and serve over the rice with spring onions.

m.note: Beef meatballs, tomato sauce, melted mozzarella.
m.how: Mix the mince, crumbs, egg, parmesan, oregano and salt and roll into 16 balls. Brown the meatballs in the oil, then pour in the sauce and simmer until cooked through. Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce and lay the mozzarella on top. Grill until the cheese melts and serve hot.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream rolled in toasted coconut with mango sauce, a disco ball on a plate.
w.how: Toast the coconut in a dry pan until golden, then cool. Scoop 8 big balls of ice cream, roll in the coconut and freeze on a lined tray. Blend the mango with the honey and a squeeze of lime. Serve two snowballs each in a puddle of mango sauce.

d.note: Orange, pineapple and passionfruit juices topped with soda.
d.how: Mix the orange and pineapple juice with the passionfruit pulp in a big jug. Add the ice and orange slices and top with lemonade just before serving.

shopping: 4 small pita breads or pizza bases@Bakery
